reference_summary: Plan with discovery, foundation, core build, integration and launch; mobile push requirement deferred because the mobile app is out of scope. Modular monolith with web frontend, application service, adapters for point of sale, e-commerce order service and campaign tool, notification worker, PostgreSQL and Redis cache for balance lookups under 200 ms. Contradictions escalated: on-premises versus AWS Lambda, 2 versus 7 year retention, and a 6 week deadline that is infeasible. Schedule far longer than 6 weeks with 4 engineers. Recommended stack: cloud portable containers, Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka or SQS.
